## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

Describe the tests and manual checks actually run, including Windows version/display scaling for UI changes. Add screenshots or a recording where useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, local config, personal data, or generated builds are included.
